bull_bear.body: Geopolitical conflicts, supply chain disruptions, inflationary pressures
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: The company has a strong focus on innovation, with new business wins in double clutches, FEAD timing kits, and bearings
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Working capital is the current call on capital — it rose to 20,291 mn INR (about 19.7% of sales) driven mainly by inventories, and management states levels will be brought back in check in coming quarters.
- Investment is being funded while cash generation is compressed: free cash flow was 2,335 mn INR for 6M 2026 versus 5,239 mn INR a year earlier, squeezed by higher working capital and lower earnings rather than by higher capex.
- The stated philosophy in the closing message is a commitment to deliver results and drive long-term stakeholder value; the deck does not lay out a dividend or buyback policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Automotive Technologies: 37%, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions: 35%, Industrial Solutions: 12%, Exports: 16%
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Revenue is spread across three roughly balanced pillars plus exports: Automotive Technologies 35% of Q2 2026 sales, Bearings & Industrial Solutions 35%, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions 12% and Intercompany Exports & others 17% — a mix that blends OEM, aftermarket and industrial cycles.
- The company is embedded in the Schaeffler AG global network, with exports mainly to group companies, giving it a captive channel alongside its domestic OEM and aftermarket business.
- Deep, quality-led OEM entrenchment is evidenced by the Q2 award slate: zero-PPM and Best Value Creation awards from Denso India, Zero PPM and Supplier of the Year (runner-up) from Toyota Kirloskar Auto Parts, Hall of Fame from John Deere, Best Partner 2025 from Voith Turbo and a Special Support award from Escorts Kubota.
- End-market exposure spans passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, tractors, two/three wheelers and core industrial sectors (cement, steel, coal, electricity), which the deck tracks explicitly as its demand drivers.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiary] KRSV Innovative Auto Solutions Private Limited is a loss-making consolidation drag — on 791 mn INR of Q2 2026 revenue it posted a -17.3% EBITDA and -19.1% EBIT margin, pulling consolidated EBITDA margin to 18.5% from 19.1% standalone.
- [Cost headwind] Management attributes the marginal decline in earnings quality to geopolitical developments, specifically fuel prices and a depreciating INR, rather than to pricing or mix.
- [CSR] The company was recognised in the Tribal and Indigenous Communities Development category at the CSR Convention and Best Practices in CSR Awards 2026, indicating community-development programmes as its main disclosed CSR thrust.
- [Sourcing] Sandvik Mining and Rock Technology India recognised the company with an Agile, Customer-Focused Cost Excellence and Efficient Sourcing award, the deck's only signal on cost and sourcing capability.

deepdive.thesis: Schaeffler India Limited is a leading manufacturer of automotive and industrial components, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. The company has sustained double-digit growth momentum in Automotive Technologies, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions, and Exports. With a commitment to delivering results and driving long-term stakeholder value, Schaeffler India Limited is well-positioned for future growth.
